intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Nekonote LLC (“Nekonote,” “Souschef,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) collects, uses, stores, and shares information when you use the Souschef mobile application, website, shared recipe pages, help center, and related services collectively referred to as the “Services.”
Nekonote LLC is the operator of Souschef and is responsible for the processing of personal information described in this Privacy Policy.

blocks.text: The information we collect depends on how you use Souschef.
Account information
When you create or manage a Souschef account, we may collect:

items: Your first and last name
Your email address
Authentication information and account identifiers
Your language and communication preferences
The date your account was created and your latest account activity

blocks.text: We do not directly collect or store your full payment card information.
Recipes and other content you provide
Souschef stores content you create, upload, save, import, or generate through the Services. This may include:

items: Recipe titles, ingredients, instructions, servings, notes, tags, and nutrition information
Recipe source links and information extracted from websites or social media posts
Captions, transcripts, and other publicly available source content used to import recipes
Photos, screenshots, cookbook pages, and printed recipe cards
Receipt photos and pantry or refrigerator photos
Pantry items and shopping-list items
AI Discovery prompts and search requests
Recipe translations, AI-generated tags, nutrition estimates, and other AI-generated results
Content you include in support requests or feedback

blocks.text: Photos and receipts can unintentionally contain names, faces, addresses, loyalty numbers, partial payment details, or other personal information. Please crop or remove unrelated personal information before uploading an image to Souschef.
Information collected automatically
When you use the Services, we and our service providers may automatically collect technical and usage information such as:

items: Device type and model
Operating system and app version
IP address
Language, country, and approximate general location inferred from an IP address
Device, installation, or advertising identifiers
App launch times, feature interactions, and timestamps
Crash reports, error logs, performance information, and other technical diagnostics
Advertising impressions, interactions, and clicks
Network and request information used to operate and secure the Services

blocks.text: We do not request precise GPS location for Souschef’s core features. However, advertising providers may estimate a general location from an IP address.
Subscription and purchase information
If you subscribe to Souschef Plus, we may receive information from Apple, Google, and RevenueCat, including:

items: An app or subscription user identifier
The product or subscription selected
Purchase, renewal, cancellation, expiration, and trial status
Transaction identifiers, receipts, or purchase tokens
The storefront, platform, and currency associated with the purchase
Limited device and technical information related to the transaction

blocks.text: Apple and Google process your payment information under their own privacy policies. Souschef does not receive your full payment card number.
Communications
When you contact us or choose to receive emails, we may collect:

items: Your name and email address
The content of your message
Your survey and marketing preferences
Email delivery, bounce, unsubscribe, and complaint information
Email opening or link-interaction information, where this measurement is enabled

blocks.text: Essential messages, such as password resets, account notices, security messages, and subscription-related communications, may still be sent when necessary.
Device permissions
Depending on the features you use, Souschef may request permission to access:

items: Your camera, when you choose to photograph a recipe, receipt, pantry, or refrigerator
Selected photos from your photo library
Notifications, including timer or app notifications

blocks.text: You can manage these permissions through your device settings.
We use information to:

items: Create, authenticate, and maintain your account
Store and synchronize your recipes across devices
Import recipes from websites, social media, photos, screenshots, and text
Extract and organize recipe ingredients and instructions
Provide AI tagging, translation, nutrition estimates, and recipe discovery
Maintain your pantry, shopping lists, timers, and cooking tools
Process and verify Souschef Plus subscriptions
Display and measure advertising in the free version of Souschef
Send transactional, survey, and marketing communications
Respond to support requests and feedback
Diagnose crashes and technical problems
Monitor performance and improve the Services
Detect fraud, abuse, security incidents, and violations of our terms
Comply with legal obligations and protect our legal rights

blocks.text: We may also create aggregated or de-identified information that cannot reasonably identify an individual and use it for analytics, research, and service improvement.
Souschef uses artificial intelligence to provide features such as recipe importing, photo scanning, AI tagging, recipe translation, nutrition estimates, and AI Discovery.

When you use one of these features, the content needed to complete your request may be sent to OpenRouter and to the AI model provider selected to process the request. Depending on the feature, this may include:

items: Recipe text
Ingredients and instructions
Photos or screenshots
Receipt or pantry images
Source captions or transcripts
Search prompts
Pantry information included in a search
The language into which you request a translation

blocks.text: We do not intentionally include your name or email address in an AI request unless you place that information inside the content you submit.

OpenRouter may route requests to different AI model providers. Retention and training practices can vary depending on the selected model, provider, and routing configuration. Providers may temporarily retain inputs and outputs for service operation, safety monitoring, abuse prevention, or legal compliance.
Do not submit confidential information, account passwords, financial information, medical records, or other highly sensitive personal information through Souschef’s AI features.
AI-generated results that you save, such as translated recipes, tags, and nutrition estimates, may remain in your Souschef account until you edit or delete them or delete your account.
Free users may see advertisements during the recipe-import process. Souschef Plus removes advertising from the import experience.
We use Google AdMob to deliver, limit, secure, and measure advertisements. Google AdMob may automatically process information such as:

items: IP address and general location inferred from it
Device and advertising identifiers
App launches, taps, video views, and other interactions
Advertisements shown and interactions with those advertisements
Crash, performance, and diagnostic information
Information used to prevent advertising fraud and abuse

blocks.text: Depending on your location, consent choices, device settings, and our advertising configuration, advertisements may be personalized or non-personalized.

You may be able to manage advertising choices through a privacy-options message presented in the app and through the privacy and advertising settings on your device. Resetting or limiting your advertising identifier may affect ad personalization but may not prevent all advertising data processing.
We do not sell your recipes, photos, account information, or other user-created content to advertisers.

Some privacy laws define certain disclosures for personalized or cross-context behavioral advertising as a “sale,” “sharing,” or “targeted advertising,” even when no money is exchanged. Where those laws apply, you may have the right to opt out of that processing.
We use third-party service providers to operate Souschef. These providers process information only for the relevant service or as otherwise described in their own terms and privacy documentation.
Current providers include:

items: **Supabase:** Authentication, database services, and cloud file storage. Supabase may process account information, saved recipes, uploaded files, and other stored user content.
**Railway:** Backend application hosting and processing. Railway may process information transmitted through Souschef’s servers, as well as server logs and operational information.
**OpenRouter and downstream AI providers:** AI processing for recipe extraction, images, tagging, translation, nutrition, discovery, and related features.
**Sentry:** Crash reporting, performance monitoring, and technical diagnostics. We configure Sentry to receive technical diagnostic information rather than recipe or photo content.

**RevenueCat:** Subscription management and purchase verification. RevenueCat may receive app user identifiers, device information, purchase history, subscription status, Apple receipts, and Google purchase tokens.
**Resend:** Transactional, survey, and marketing email delivery. Resend may process names, email addresses, message content, communication preferences, and delivery information.
**Google AdMob:** Advertising delivery, measurement, analytics, and fraud prevention.
**Apple App Store and Google Play:** App distribution, payment processing, subscription management, and purchase records.

blocks.text: We may replace or add providers as the Services evolve. Any provider is permitted to process information only for the purposes for which it was engaged, subject to applicable agreements and law.
We may disclose information:

items: To service providers that help us operate Souschef
When you direct us to share information
When you create or share a recipe link
To comply with a legal requirement, court order, or lawful government request
To investigate fraud, security incidents, abuse, or violations of our terms
To protect the rights, property, and safety of Nekonote, our users, or others
In connection with a merger, financing, acquisition, reorganization, bankruptcy, or sale of some or all of our business
With your consent

blocks.text: When you create or send a shared recipe link, anyone who receives or accesses that link may be able to view the recipe information included on the shared page. Do not include private information in recipes you intend to share.

We do not sell personal information for monetary payment. As described above, advertising-related disclosures may nevertheless be legally considered “sharing,” “sale,” or “targeted advertising” in certain jurisdictions.
Where the European Economic Area, United Kingdom, or similar laws apply, we rely on the following legal bases:

items: **Performance of a contract:** To create your account, store recipes, provide requested features, and manage subscriptions.
**Legitimate interests:** To secure, maintain, troubleshoot, and improve Souschef, prevent fraud, and understand service performance.
**Consent:** For optional marketing communications, device permissions, and personalized advertising where consent is required.
**Legal obligations:** To retain required business records, respond to lawful requests, and comply with applicable law.

blocks.text: You may withdraw consent at any time. Withdrawal does not affect processing that occurred before consent was withdrawn.
We generally retain account information and saved user content for as long as your account remains active or as needed to provide the Services.
When you delete your account, we will begin deleting your account information and saved content from our active systems. Limited information may remain temporarily:

items: In encrypted backups until those backups are overwritten
In security, fraud-prevention, or diagnostic logs
Where required to comply with tax, accounting, legal, or regulatory obligations
Where necessary to establish, exercise, or defend legal claims
In systems operated independently by Apple, Google, or other third parties

blocks.text: AI providers, advertising providers, email providers, and other service providers may retain information according to their applicable retention practices.
Deleting your Souschef account does not automatically cancel an App Store or Google Play subscription. You should cancel an active subscription through Apple or Google before deleting your account.
You may delete your Souschef account through the account or settings section of the app.

You may also request deletion by emailing [compliance@nekonote.co](mailto:compliance@nekonote.co) or [support@nekonote.co](mailto:support@nekonote.co) from the email address associated with your account.
We may need to verify your identity before completing a privacy request. Certain information may be retained where permitted or required by law.

We use reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational measures intended to protect personal information. These measures may include encryption in transit, encryption at rest where supported, authentication controls, access restrictions, logging, and security monitoring.
No electronic transmission or storage system is completely secure. We therefore cannot guarantee that information will never be accessed, disclosed, altered, or lost without authorization.
Nekonote and its service providers may process information in the United States and other countries that may have different privacy laws from your country.
Where required, we use appropriate safeguards for international transfers, such as contractual data-protection terms or other legally recognized transfer mechanisms.
Depending on where you live, you may have the right to:

items: Access personal information we hold about you
Correct inaccurate information
Request deletion of your information
Receive a portable copy of certain information
Restrict or object to certain processing
Withdraw consent
Opt out of marketing communications
Opt out of certain targeted advertising, sale, or sharing
Appeal a decision concerning a privacy request
Lodge a complaint with a privacy or data-protection authority
Exercise your rights without discriminatory treatment

blocks.text: You can update certain information and delete your account inside the app. You can unsubscribe from optional emails through the email-preferences settings or the unsubscribe link in an email.
You may submit other privacy requests to [compliance@nekonote.co](mailto:compliance@nekonote.co).
Souschef is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.
Where local law requires a higher minimum age to consent to online data processing, users below that age should use Souschef only with authorization from a parent or legal guardian.

If you believe a child has provided personal information without appropriate authorization, contact us at [compliance@nekonote.co](mailto:compliance@nekonote.co) so we can investigate and delete the information where required.
Souschef lets users import content from third-party websites and platforms. Those websites and platforms are governed by their own terms and privacy policies.
This Privacy Policy does not govern information collected directly by third parties when you visit their websites, use their apps, purchase through an app store, or interact with an advertisement.
You are responsible for ensuring that you have the right to upload, import, store, or share content through Souschef.
We may update this Privacy Policy as Souschef changes or as required by law.

When we make material changes, we may provide notice through the app, by email, or by updating the date at the top of this policy. Your continued use of the Services after an updated policy becomes effective is subject to the updated policy, to the extent permitted by law.
Questions, requests, or concerns about this Privacy Policy may be sent to:
**Nekonote LLC**
**Email:** [compliance@nekonote.co](mailto:compliance@nekonote.co)
**Support:** [support@nekonote.co](mailto:support@nekonote.co)
